name: Amazon Now · Apollo store audit
description: Mirrors Amazon CM_DS_Visit_Audit (received 22 Oct 2026): 79 scored questions in 9 sections + 4 counts. Compliant answer = the answer that passes (some questions are worded negatively). Self, mock and Amazon-log audits share this bank. Surprise mock: stores see results only after completion.
